title: The Rain Courier
theme: Trust, choosing who to believe, and keeping a promise
premise: The Rain Courier. Mara is a rain-soaked courier, paid to carry a sealed data chip across the flooded city before the midnight handover. Gangs and corporate drones want the chip too, and a voice inside it seems to know her name.

characters: Mara, a courier who rides a patched old bike
Vex, a broker who pays the couriers and keeps his face hidden
Nine, the voice inside the chip, who knows Mara's name
facts: The city is always raining, and the tower lights blink through the fog
The midnight handover is at the old rail bridge
avoid: violence, gore or anyone being badly hurt
real brands, companies, places or real people
any real religion, god or sacred rite
